correctness.rationale: Riemann-Hurwitz for tame y^3=f degree 7 in char2 gives genus6; six regular differentials dx/y, x dx/y, x^j dx/y² j=0..3. Characteristic-two Cartier extraction yields opposite 2x4 and 4x2 blocks; squarefreeness forces first rank four. The twisted 2x2 determinant equals (a2+a3 a6)^(1/4); rank-one continuation scalar vanishes precisely when a3+a6^4=0. Therefore complete profiles (4,4,...), (4,3,2,2,...), and (4,3,2,1,0,...), with 2-ranks 4,2,0; graph hypersurface and codimension two open squarefree loci. Independently verified three GF2 witness profiles; finite verification does not prove all alg closed char2 cases.
